images.title: Two bells, one moment
images.purpose: Show that two bells ringing at different gaps start together, and invite the question of when they ring together again.
images.composition: Two bells stacked on the left, one above the other, each with its own row of ring marks stretching to the right, lots of white space.
images.exact_structure: Upper: one teal #0072B2 temple bell, then a row of exactly 5 equal round marks with equal gaps. Lower: one amber #E69F00 temple bell, then a row of exactly 3 round marks with equal but wider gaps. The first mark of each row sits in the same vertical line, ringed in reddish purple #CC79A7 with a thin grey #6B7280 dashed line joining them. No other mark lines up. No numbers written. Exactly 2 bells, 8 marks.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame

bell rows that line up at any mark except the first
any number of seconds or gap length written
images.takeaway: Two bells ring together once, and we wonder when it happens again.
images.description: Two temple bells, teal and amber, each with a row of ring marks; the first marks line up in purple and the later ones do not.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at where the bells rang together and guess when they might meet again, without giving an answer.

image_decisions.why: One clean picture carries the main idea of this concept.
